t: Presents are found in Chests throughout the Overworld. $(br2) When a Present is placed, the wrapping colors are chosen randomly. Presents can be picked up with Silk Touch. $(br2)Breaking a Present open will reveal the gift inside. Gifts rang from really good to "Gee, you sholdn't have!"
礼物堆散落在主世界各处的宝箱中。$(br2)放置礼物堆时，包装颜色将随机生成。使用精准采集可完整拾起礼物堆。$(br2)破坏礼物堆将揭示其中所藏礼物，奖品从极佳到“哎呀，您真不必如此破费！”不等。
